C1813.title: RoboPAIR Embodied Robot Jailbreak Research
C1813.summary: In October 2024, the University of Pennsylvania George Pappas team proposed RoboPAIR, the first systematic jailbreak algorithm against LLM-controlled robots. It demonstrated on white-box NVIDIA Dolphins autonomous-driving LLM, gray-box Clearpath Jackal UGV, and black-box Unitree Go2+GPT-3.5, often achieving 100% attack success, inducing robots to perform harmful physical actions such as finding weapons, striking pedestrians, and ignoring stop signs. This is the first successful jailbreak of a commercially deployed robot system, published at ICRA 2025.
